tables.name: core.organizations
tables.fact_owner: Legal ERP tenant identity and operating defaults

cross_row_invariants.name: organizations_state_transition
cross_row_invariants.rule: Updates permit only declared lifecycle transitions; closed organizations are immutable except legal-retention metadata.

cross_row_invariants.name: branches_state_transition
cross_row_invariants.rule: Updates permit only declared lifecycle transitions and reject reactivation of a closed branch.

tables.name: core.users
tables.fact_owner: Global ERP profile mapped one-to-zero-or-one to Supabase Auth

cross_row_invariants.name: users_state_transition
cross_row_invariants.rule: Updates permit only declared lifecycle transitions; anonymized profiles cannot be restored or remapped to Auth.

tables.name: core.memberships
tables.fact_owner: A user's durable membership in one organization

cross_row_invariants.name: memberships_state_transition
cross_row_invariants.rule: Updates permit only declared lifecycle transitions; revoked memberships never reactivate and retain actor evidence.

checks.name: memberships_dates_ck
checks.expression: (status = 'invited' AND joined_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('active','suspended') AND joined_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'revoked' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: memberships_revocation_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'revoked' OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revocation_reason IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: core.role_permissions
tables.fact_owner: Permission membership of a tenant role

tables.name: core.access_grants
tables.fact_owner: Assignment of one role to one membership at organization or branch scope

cross_row_invariants.name: access_grants_state_transition
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only active grants may transition to revoked or expired; terminal grants cannot reactivate and expiry is evaluated transactionally.

checks.name: access_grants_scope_ck
checks.expression: (scope_kind = 'organization' AND branch_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind = 'branch' AND branch_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: access_grants_expiry_ck
checks.expression: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > valid_from_at

checks.name: access_grants_revocation_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'revoked' OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND revocation_reason IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: access_grants_active_org_uq
indexes.purpose: one active organization-scoped role assignment despite NULL semantics

indexes.name: access_grants_active_branch_uq
indexes.where: status = 'active' AND branch_id IS NOT NULL

tables.name: core.settings
tables.fact_owner: Typed tenant configuration value at organization or branch scope

cross_row_invariants.name: settings_state_transition
cross_row_invariants.rule: A retired setting version cannot be reactivated; replacement is a new row and is audited.

checks.name: settings_scope_ck
checks.expression: (scope_kind = 'organization' AND branch_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind = 'branch' AND branch_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: settings_typed_value_ck
checks.expression: num_nonnulls(value_text,value_numeric,value_boolean,value_date,value_timestamptz) = 1 AND value_type IN ('text','numeric','boolean','date','timestamptz') AND (value_type = 'text') = (value_text IS NOT NULL) AND (value_type = 'numeric') = (value_numeric IS NOT NULL) AND (value_type = 'boolean') = (value_boolean IS NOT NULL) AND (value_type = 'date') = (value_date IS NOT NULL) AND (value_type = 'timestamptz') = (value_timestamptz IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: settings_active_org_key_uq
indexes.purpose: one active organization setting despite NULL semantics

indexes.name: settings_active_branch_key_uq
indexes.where: status = 'active' AND branch_id IS NOT NULL

tables.name: core.document_sequences
tables.fact_owner: Atomic next document number for one tenant scope and fiscal period

cross_row_invariants.name: document_sequences_atomic_allocation
cross_row_invariants.rule: Allocation locks exactly one active sequence row, increments once after idempotency ownership, never reuses a number, and never reopens a closed sequence.

indexes.name: document_sequences_org_scope_uq
indexes.purpose: one organization sequence despite NULL semantics

tables.name: core.idempotency_keys
tables.fact_owner: Exact request identity and replay response for a mutation scope

cross_row_invariants.name: idempotency_claim_once
cross_row_invariants.rule: The scope key is claimed atomically; equal request hashes replay the exact terminal response, different hashes conflict, and terminal rows never transition again.

checks.name: idempotency_keys_hashes_ck
checks.expression: octet_length(idempotency_key_hash) = 32 AND octet_length(request_hash) = 32 AND (response_hash IS NULL OR octet_length(response_hash) = 32)

checks.name: idempotency_keys_terminal_ck
checks.expression: status = 'claimed' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL

checks.name: idempotency_keys_response_ck
checks.expression: response_body IS NULL OR (response_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599 AND response_media_type IS NOT NULL AND response_hash IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: core.audit_events
tables.fact_owner: Immutable security and business mutation audit event

cross_row_invariants.name: audit_events_append_only
cross_row_invariants.rule: Audit events reject UPDATE and DELETE. Serialize the reviewed row fields deterministically, persist SHA-256 before_state_hash and after_state_hash according to mutation_kind, and compute evidence_hash from canonical event fields plus previous_event_hash while holding one organization-scoped chain lock.

checks.name: audit_events_actor_ck
checks.expression: actor_kind IN ('membership','system','migration') AND (actor_kind = 'membership') = (actor_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: audit_events_mutation_ck
checks.expression: mutation_kind IN ('insert','update','delete','command') AND ((mutation_kind='insert' AND before_state_hash IS NULL AND after_state_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (mutation_kind='update' AND before_state_hash IS NOT NULL AND after_state_hash IS NOT NULL) OR (mutation_kind='delete' AND before_state_hash IS NOT NULL AND after_state_hash IS NULL) OR (mutation_kind='command' AND after_state_hash IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: audit_events_hash_ck
checks.expression: evidence_version='pg-jsonb-sha256-v1' AND octet_length(evidence_hash) = 32 AND (before_state_hash IS NULL OR octet_length(before_state_hash) = 32) AND (after_state_hash IS NULL OR octet_length(after_state_hash) = 32) AND (previous_event_hash IS NULL OR octet_length(previous_event_hash) = 32)

tables.name: core.outbox_events
tables.fact_owner: Durable delivery state for one canonical integration event

cross_row_invariants.name: outbox_delivery_transition
cross_row_invariants.rule: Payload and aggregate identity are immutable; only declared delivery-state transitions and monotonic attempt counters are allowed.

checks.name: outbox_events_terminal_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'published' OR published_at IS NOT NULL

tables.name: core.data_retention_cases
tables.fact_owner: Reviewed purpose-end, statutory-retention and legal-hold decision for exactly one personal-data subject in one tenant

cross_row_invariants.name: data_retention_cases_command_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the reviewed retention command creates or advances a case. Eligibility requires verified evidence, purpose end, statutory_retention_until in the past, no legal hold, an active authorized reviewer distinct from the subject where the subject is a membership, and exactly one typed subject. Completion pseudonymizes mutable direct identifiers in the typed subject and linked user only when every active membership for that global user is independently eligible; statutory document, ledger, audit and surrogate relationship facts are retained.

uniques.name: data_retention_cases_membership_open_uq
uniques.where: membership_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('reviewed','eligible')

uniques.name: data_retention_cases_employee_open_uq
uniques.where: employee_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('reviewed','eligible')

uniques.name: data_retention_cases_party_open_uq
uniques.where: party_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('reviewed','eligible')

uniques.name: data_retention_cases_contact_open_uq
uniques.where: contact_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('reviewed','eligible')

checks.name: data_retention_cases_subject_ck
checks.expression: num_nonnulls(membership_id,employee_id,party_id,contact_id)=1 AND ((subject_kind='membership' AND membership_id IS NOT NULL) OR (subject_kind='employee' AND employee_id IS NOT NULL) OR (subject_kind='party' AND party_id IS NOT NULL) OR (subject_kind='contact' AND contact_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: data_retention_cases_hold_ck
checks.expression: (legal_hold AND btrim(COALESCE(legal_hold_reason,''))<>'') OR (NOT legal_hold AND legal_hold_reason IS NULL)

checks.name: data_retention_cases_completion_ck
checks.expression: (status='completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'completed' AND completed_at IS NULL AND completed_by_membership_id IS NULL)

tables.name: core.reference_data_releases
tables.fact_owner: Immutable reviewed source and exact-set identity for one deployed global regulatory reference dataset

cross_row_invariants.name: reference_data_release_import
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the isolated regulatory importer may create a staged release. It accepts only a dataset-kind-specific official authority host, verifies supplied source bytes and canonical parsed dataset bytes against their SHA-256 hashes, and records immutable object-storage coordinates for later retrieval. A typed core.users reviewer, exact non-empty row set, prior-product invalidation, prior-release supersession and new activation occur atomically. Release evidence is immutable, there is exactly one active release per dataset_kind, and runtime or MCP principals cannot import or select a ruleset.

checks.name: reference_data_releases_authority_ck
checks.expression: (dataset_kind='ingredient_classification' AND source_authority='cdsco') OR (dataset_kind='hsn_sac_tax' AND source_authority IN ('gst_portal','gst_council','cbic','gstn')) OR (dataset_kind='withholding_rules' AND source_authority IN ('income_tax_department','cbic')) OR (dataset_kind='controlled_movement_rules' AND source_authority IN ('cdsco','revenue_department')) OR (dataset_kind IN ('einvoice_rules','gst_adjustment_rules') AND source_authority IN ('gst_portal','gst_council','cbic','gstn'))

checks.name: reference_data_releases_dates_ck
checks.expression: publication_date <= effective_from AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from) AND reviewed_at <= created_at

checks.name: reference_data_releases_text_ck
checks.expression: btrim(ruleset_version)<>'' AND btrim(source_uri)<>'' AND btrim(source_storage_bucket)<>'' AND btrim(source_storage_object_path)<>'' AND btrim(dataset_storage_bucket)<>'' AND btrim(dataset_storage_object_path)<>''

indexes.name: reference_data_releases_active_kind_uq
indexes.purpose: one exact active statutory dataset per reference kind

indexes.name: reference_data_releases_effective_idx
indexes.purpose: ruleset provenance lookup by effective date

tables.name: core.attachments
tables.fact_owner: ERP evidence metadata and integrity hash for one externally stored object

cross_row_invariants.name: attachments_evidence_immutability
cross_row_invariants.rule: After verification, object path, byte size, media type, SHA-256 and evidence kind cannot change; legal hold prevents retirement.

checks.name: attachments_verified_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('verified','retained') OR verified_at IS NOT NULL
